approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: A DOCX table containing consecutive RFI and Submittal sections is currently emitted as one fragment and the entire fragment receives the final section label.
Reuse the existing deterministic line-group splitter while carrying workflow state across DOCX body elements, so each exact role/status boundary has its own evidence fragment.
Do not add a DOCX library, semantic inference, approval authority or model call; keep existing resource limits and native element locators.
Completed with 656 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment tests; parser/API/full-suite gates, spec sync and the 374-file source manifest passed offline.
title: Split DOCX table workflow evidence scopes
objective: Prevent one multi-section DOCX table fragment from assigning an RFI question to a later Submittal status while preserving logical text, revision data and native element locators.
